overall.verdict: The xln dark mobile wallet establishes an extraordinary standard of financial transparency, deterministic verification, and absolute bar scaling that blows away conventional Web3 interfaces. However, mobile interaction bugs—specifically floating primary CTA buttons frequently clipping inputs and scroll containers—alongside pervasive consensus-level jargon currently hamper onboarding for ordinary users.
priority_fixes: Fix floating action button container styling across Pay, Swap, and Move screens by establishing a rigid 96px bottom-safe scroll margin so inputs and disclosures are never occluded.
Calibrate order book depth bars on Swap screen to reflect genuine absolute/relative volume scales rather than uniform fixed widths.
Translate raw protocol mechanics into accessible plain-language tooltips across On-chain vs Reserve vs Promised balances, especially demystifying 'Lazy board' and 'Depository may pull'.
Restructure multi-card selection matrices (notably the 3x2 Move screen and Lend/Borrow flow) into intuitive directional steppers to eliminate touch ambiguity.
Add one-tap share, CSV/PDF export, and clipboard triggers to all receipt, transaction detail, and evidence bundle views.
